report_context.sample_note: This run uses 600 exact image files and verifies every SHA-256 checksum before inference. It contains 200 deterministic samples from each lung class.
report_context.source_note: All images come from the lung portion of LC25000. The dataset contains augmented derivatives of a smaller original collection, so samples are not patient-independent.

prompts.benign lung tissue: benign lung tissue with open alveolar spaces, delicate septa, bland pneumocytes, and no cytologic atypia
prompts.lung adenocarcinoma: lung adenocarcinoma with malignant gland formation, acinar or lepidic growth, atypical columnar cells, and possible mucin
prompts.lung squamous cell carcinoma: lung squamous cell carcinoma with atypical squamous nests, keratin pearls, intercellular bridges, and eosinophilic cytoplasm

case_sets.source_note: Every 25th class row from LC25000 commit 2387ffed63932faa8fd05c679ffec85fc3153f61, selected before model inference.
